definitions.explanation: The act of entrusting a task or responsibility to someone.

definitions.gloss: non-regular employee; contract worker; part-time staff
definitions.explanation: An employee hired on a contract basis, often a retired person rehired at reduced pay and hours. Common in Japanese government offices and companies.

examples.japanese: {調査|ちょうさ}を{専門家|せんもんか}に{嘱託|しょくたく}した。
examples.english: We commissioned the investigation to an expert.

examples.japanese: {外部|がいぶ}の{弁護士|べんごし}に{法務|ほうむ}を{嘱託|しょくたく}する。
examples.english: To entrust legal affairs to an outside lawyer.

examples.japanese: {嘱託|しょくたく}の{仕事|しごと}は{週|しゅう}に{三日|みっか}だ。
examples.english: The contract position is three days a week.

examples.japanese: {定年|ていねん}{後|ご}は{嘱託|しょくたく}として{働|はたら}いている。
examples.english: After retirement, I am working as a contract employee.

examples.japanese: {嘱託|しょくたく}{社員|しゃいん}には{正社員|せいしゃいん}と{同|おな}じ{福利厚生|ふくりこうせい}は{適用|てきよう}されない。
examples.english: Contract employees do not receive the same benefits as regular employees.

examples.japanese: {市役所|しやくしょ}では{嘱託|しょくたく}{職員|しょくいん}を{募集|ぼしゅう}している。
examples.english: The city hall is recruiting contract staff.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {嘱|しょく} (entrust) + {託|たく} (entrust, commission). Sense 1 is used as a suru verb ({嘱託|しょくたく}する). Sense 2 is commonly used as a noun modifier ({嘱託|しょくたく}{社員|しゃいん}, {嘱託|しょくたく}{職員|しょくいん}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {嘱託|しょくたく}{社員|しゃいん} (contract employee)
- {嘱託|しょくたく}{職員|しょくいん} (contract staff)
- {嘱託|しょくたく}{医|い} (consulting physician)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {契約|けいやく}{社員|しゃいん}: contract employee — a broader term for any contract-based worker
- {派遣|はけん}{社員|しゃいん}: temporary worker — sent by a staffing agency
- {正社員|せいしゃいん}: regular employee — a permanent, full-time employee
